events.title: Murad II defeats John Hunyadi in the Second Battle of Kosovo
events.description: The Ottoman army of Sultan Murad II defeated the Hungarian and Wallachian army of John Hunyadi on the Kosovo plain, ending his hope of reversing the defeat at Varna. He was then briefly held captive by the Serbian despot Đurađ Branković.

events.title: The Duke of Alba defeats William the Silent at Jodoigne
events.description: At Jodoigne, the royal Habsburg army of the Duke of Alba, governor of the Netherlands, defeated a Protestant rebel army led by William the Silent, Prince of Orange, who had to abandon his plans to invade the Habsburg Netherlands.
events.html: At Jodoigne, the royal Habsburg army of the Duke of Alba, governor of the Netherlands, defeated a Protestant rebel army led by William the Silent, Prince of Orange, who had to abandon his plans to invade the Habsburg Netherlands.

events.title: Maria Theresa inherits the Habsburg lands
events.description: The death of Emperor Charles VI left his 23-year-old daughter Maria Theresa ruler of Austria, Hungary and Bohemia. She fought off Frederick the Great's challenge and reformed the state over a 40-year reign.
events.html: The death of Emperor Charles VI left his 23-year-old daughter Maria Theresa ruler of Austria, Hungary and Bohemia. She fought off Frederick the Great's challenge and reformed the state over a 40-year reign.

events.title: The First Continental Congress adopts the Continental Association
events.description: Meeting in Carpenters' Hall in Philadelphia, the First Continental Congress adopted the Continental Association, a colonial boycott of British trade. Congress hoped the sanctions would pressure Parliament to address the colonies' grievances, especially by repealing the Intolerable Acts.

events.title: The US Senate ratifies the Louisiana Purchase
events.description: The Senate approved the treaty buying Louisiana from France by 24 votes to 7. For 15 million dollars, the United States gained some 828,000 square miles, roughly doubling its territory.
events.html: The Senate approved the treaty buying Louisiana from France by 24 votes to 7. For 15 million dollars, the United States gained some 828,000 square miles, roughly doubling its territory.

events.title: Allied fleets destroy the Ottoman-Egyptian navy at Navarino
events.description: British, French and Russian squadrons destroyed the Ottoman and Egyptian fleet in Navarino Bay, Greece. The last major battle fought entirely by sailing ships, it secured Greek independence.
events.html: British, French and Russian squadrons destroyed the Ottoman and Egyptian fleet in Navarino Bay, Greece. The last major battle fought entirely by sailing ships, it secured Greek independence.

events.title: US forces land on Leyte as MacArthur returns
events.description: American troops landed on Leyte, and General Douglas MacArthur waded ashore to fulfil his 1942 promise to return to the Philippines. Days later, the Battle of Leyte Gulf crippled the Japanese navy.
events.html: American troops landed on Leyte, and General Douglas MacArthur waded ashore to fulfil his 1942 promise to return to the Philippines. Days later, the Battle of Leyte Gulf crippled the Japanese navy.

events.title: Muammar Gaddafi is captured and killed near Sirte
events.description: Rebel fighters captured Muammar Gaddafi near his hometown of Sirte and killed him shortly afterwards. His death ended 42 years of rule and the Libyan civil war.
